_doc: Opt-in per-channel VPS transcode control. Owner override 2026-06-20 (DIRECTIVA TRANSCODE VPS PERMITIDO). ONLY channels with enabled=true are transcoded; everything else stays SHIELDED passthrough. Deploy target: /etc/ape/crystal_transcode_control.json
_owner_override: 2026-06-20 VPS pixel transcode PERMITTED (async service only, opt-in, FREEZELESS passthrough fallback)
_warning: Real-time transcode is GPU/CPU bound. With no GPU keep max_concurrent_cpu=1. 8K real-time needs a GPU. Flag flagship channels ONLY, never the full catalog.

channels._note: Set enabled=true and a real verbatim provider URL to transcode this one channel. SHIELDED is terminated only for this channel.
8K real-time requires a GPU. Leave disabled on a CPU-only VPS.
